messages:
Alice K.: Quick question — we have a staging worker that talks to a vendor and needs a long-lived API key. Right now someone committed an encrypted blob to infra-config and our CI decrypts with a CMK. Is that acceptable as a short-term practice or should we move straight to Vault/Secrets Manager? Also: how do we make sure we never leak the key in logs? :eyes:
Ben M.: Short version: not ideal but workable short-term if you control the CMK policy + rotation. Longer term move to Vault or AWS Secrets Manager with IAM access from CI. Avoid storing any ciphertext that you can't rotate the key for. For logs: scrub at emitter and add a structured-field allowlist. Example blunt scrub: `log_line.replace(api_key, '[REDACTED]')`
Jaspreet: If you keep the CMK approach, do two things: 1) CMK policy should only allow `Decrypt` for the CI role (no individual dev principals). 2) Add CloudTrail alert on `Decrypt` for that key so we get notified on unexpected usage. Also require an access-request flow for granting human decrypt rights (1h max).
infra-sre: We can provision a short-lived assume-role for staging so the CI uses STS to get creds and then calls KMS. That reduces blast radius. I can set up an `assume-role` + external-id pattern this afternoon if you want. Also we should remove the blob from git history (BFG) and rotate the key after purge.
Alice K.: Good call — removing from history now, will rotate after purge. Do we have a recommended rotation cadence for vendor keys?
security-bot: Policy reminder: default secrets rotation = 90d. For external vendor keys we recommend 30d if possible. Also enable HSM-backed CMKs for production.
Ben M.: +1 on 30d for vendor keys. If vendor supports short-lived tokens, prefer that. For log redaction, add a middleware that strips any field named `api_key` before any debug/response dump. Pseudocode:
```
if 'api_key' in payload:
  payload['api_key'] = '[REDACTED]'
logger.debug(payload)
```
Nate L.: I'm okay with the temporary CMK->CI decrypt flow so long as infra does the assume-role + we rotate and we set CloudTrail alerts. I'll open an internal ticket to track migration to Vault and approve the short-term plan. :white_check_mark:
Alice K.: Thanks everyone — I'll: 1) remove the blob from repo history, 2) rotate CMK, 3) file a migration ticket to Vault/Secrets Manager, and 4) add the redaction middleware in the staging worker. I'll ping infra-sre for the assume-role setup.
infra-sre: Ping received — will DM you for details and create the role.
Jaspreet: Also add an entry to the runbook: steps to revoke/rotate if vendor key leaks. Small checklist is helpful for on-call.
Alice K.: Will do, linking to docs: https://redwood.dev/internal/secrets-handling (draft) — thanks! :bow:
